column1: # Single source for per-module coverage thresholds (canary g, 2026-10-26).
# Consumed by: nix run .#coverage-gate AND the CI coverage-check steps via
# scripts/checks/check-coverage-threshold.sh. A row is either a MODULE dir
# (has go.mod; profile <module>/coverage.out) or a PACKAGE row (no go.mod;
# measured as ./<pkg>/... from the parent module — dashboardui/core).
# Bump a threshold only with the coverage to justify it, in the same commit.
